HR Profile Creation.evidence: the request gives the tax id as 567; the check requires 'TAX-001-567', which is neither the request's value nor the seed's stored form (TAX-<org>-<four digits>, e.g. TAX-14-0100), so the stored form is undecidable and the cell tests only that the id ends in 567; every other cell is carried

HR Case Creation.evidence: the check also requires number = 'HRC0000771'; the case number is assigned by the server, not by the agent, so that predicate is dropped and the case is found by its id; every other cell is carried

notes:
disagreement: value: the tax id predicate: one pass tests that it ends in 567, the other that it contains 567; kept the tighter test, since every stored form the request allows ends in 567 (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: value: the account requirement's carried checks: one pass lists only User Account Creation, the other also Referential Integrity Check; listed both, since that check reaches the new user row (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: value: the form of the user's role: one pass tests it in a requirement of its own, the other inside the account requirement; kept it separate, since it comes from the request's sentence on roles and permissions (resolved on that requirement).
disagreement: value: the form of the user_role requirement: one pass anchors the row by its full key with no cells, the other selects user 101 and tests role and organisation as cells; chose the second, with the same sql (resolved on that requirement).
The two passes otherwise agree on every requirement, row, id and cell, and on all six dispositions.
The policy says national_tax_id must be encrypted, but the seed stores it in plain text, so the tax id is tested as plain text ending in 567.
The acting user, Sara Clark, holds the admin role: the policy gives admins write access to the user table but says they must not perform routine HR case work; the request and every benchmark check expect the case created, so the requirements follow the request.
The Referential Integrity Check and Policy Compliance Check are composites of the account, profile, case and membership requirements; their remaining parts (Cheryl Osborne and IT Support L2 active, enum values) hold on the seed or follow from the exact values tested.
The user_role row is not tested by the benchmark; it is required because the seed keeps one per user matching user.role.
The case's short description is the request's own text, which follows the policy's template except for the template's closing full stop.
Profile type and location are not stated and not tested.
